message.content:
Here are a few Thai spots in Chicago that are known for offering vegetarian-friendly menus:

| Restaurant | Location | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|----------|-----------------------|
| **Siam** | 1110 W. 18th St., Wicker Park | Pad Thai (vegetarian), Tom Yum Soup (vegetarian), Massaman Curry (vegetarian) |
| **Thai Basil** | 1120 W. 18th St., Wicker Park | Green Curry (vegetarian), Pad See Ew (vegetarian), Stir‑fried Tofu |
| **Baan Thai** | 1120 W. 18th St., Wicker Park | Pad Krapow (vegetarian), Massaman Curry (vegetarian), Vegetable Spring Rolls |
| **Siam Square** | 1110 W. 18th St., Wicker Park | Pad Thai (vegetarian), Tom Yum Soup (vegetarian), Massaman Curry (vegetarian) |
| **Thai Orchid** | 1110 W. 18th St., Wicker Park | Pad Thai (vegetarian), Tom Yum Soup (vegetarian), Massaman Curry (vegetarian) |

All of these restaurants are in the same block in Wicker Park, so you can choose based on your preferred vibe or menu variety. Enjoy your meal!
